title: WPSB/337/2019 of GABAR SINGH NEGI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (SB) No. 337 of 2019
Gabar Singh Negi ..........Petitioner
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and another ...........Respondents

Coram: Hon'ble Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.
 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J. (Oral)
Heard Mr. R.C. Tamta, learned Advocate appearing on
behalf of the petitioner, and Mr. Vikas Pande, learned Standing
Counsel for the State Government.
2. The petitioner has invoked the jurisdiction of this Court
seeking a mandamus, commanding/directing the respondents to
promote/consider the petitioner for promotion to the post of Chief
Administrative Officer by implementing Government Order/Office
Memorandum No. 90/XXX(2)/2016-30(51)15 dated 26.07.2016
issued by the Principal Secretary (Culture), Government of
Uttarakhand.
3. The petitioner is a public servant falling within the
ambit of Section 2(b)(1) of the Uttar Pradesh Public Services
Tribunal Act, 1976. He has an effective and efficacious alternate
remedy, under Section 4(1) of the said Act, to make a reference of a
claim to the Tribunal for the redressal of his grievance.
4. As the petitioner has an effective and efficacious
alternate remedy, we see no reason to exercise our discretion to
entertain this Writ Petition. Leaving it open to the petitioner to
approach the Public Services Tribunal, for redressal of his
grievance, the writ petition fails and is, accordingly, dismissed. No
costs.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Ramesh Ranganathan, C.J.)
 06.12.2019
Sanjay/NEHA
